    • getColor

      public String getColor()
      Returns a Bootstrap color context string based on the notification type.
      • JOB_POSTED → "success" (green)
      • WORKLOAD_ALERT → "danger" (red)
      • STATUS_UPDATED → "info" (cyan)
      • APPLICATION_SUBMITTED → "primary" (blue)
      • others → "secondary" (grey)
